title: Residual Student Protected Identity & Task Objective (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `residual_student` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Evaluates a residual student trained under both an adversarial task loss and an explicit identity-preservation constraint: it must achieve 100% task success with zero wrong-pad errors while keeping identity_mse <= 0.02.
failure_mode: Without conflict-resolving multi-objective updates (e.g., non-ascent gradient projection), adversarial gradients violate the identity subspace or trigger wrong-pad regressions.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `residual_student` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
